newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech declines comment on Chubb.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech declines comment on Chubb.

text.p: Regional Bell Ameritech Corp on Thursday declined comment on analysts suggestions it may be in talks about acquiring British security services provider Chubb Security Plc.
"We don't comment on rumors or speculation," an Ameritech spokeswoman said.

Chubb shares soared 24 percent in London on Thursday to close at 423 pence after it disclosed it was talking with a company that may make a recommended offer for the firm at 450 pence per share or less, around 1.3 billion stg total.
Chubb did not identify the company it was talking to.

Ameritech joined analysts' list of possible contenders because it already has a big security monitoring business in North America, which it has used as a way of squeezing more value out of its telephone network and because of its ambitions to continue expanding.
"We're the second largest (security monitoring business) in North America and we would like to be a leader in Europe too," said the spokeswoman.
